boardRow.name: The Pressure Garden
boardRow.ledgerBlurb: A geothermal terrace garden where coal tends the boilers and pressure is the crop.

goals: Run boilers on the three terraces and watch the pressure ledger.
Survive through wave 12 between the three boiler beds.
rules: The coal seams cluster on the highest terrace above the boiler beds.
The single water band has a broad north bank for legal sluice work.
Steam Wreckers attack from both growing terraces while Coal Thieves descend from the seam bed.
briefing.geographyLine: Four stepped growing terraces rise north of one clean water band.
